newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Britain's GKN wins Kuwait maintenance deal.
newsitem.headline: Britain's GKN wins Kuwait maintenance deal.

text.p: Britain's GKN Defence Ltd won a four-year contract for the maintenance of Kuwait's Warrior armoured vehicles, the British embassy said on Saturday.

"Today a contract was released by the Ministry of Defence to representatives of the British government for GKN Defence Ltd to carry out the maintenance of Kuwait land force Desert Warriors for four years," said the statement.
It did not give the value of the contract. Experts say the contract is believed to be worth tens of millions of dinars (dollars).
GKN Defence in 1993 sold Kuwait 254 Warriors worth some $925 million.
